hypothesis: A fused flash-attention-style Triton kernel with exact base-2 LSE (exp2/log2, qk_scale=sm_scale*log2e), fp32 (ieee) dot products, end-anchored causal prefix mask, GQA head packing (4 qo heads per kv head into the M dim), and torch.zeros/full allocation so only the active query tail is written, will be exactly correct and beat the Python-loop reference by a large margin. Feedback regime is num_kv<<num_q so the op is memset-bound on the mostly-zero output.
design_notes: Grid (batch, max_q_tiles, num_kv_heads); BLOCK_Q=16, BLOCK_KV=64, BLOCK_M=64, HEAD_DIM=128, num_warps=4, num_stages=2. In-kernel early-exit for tiles fully past num_q, empty num_kv, or fully below the active tail (tile_q_start+BLOCK_Q-1+delta<0). Online-softmax loop over KV blocks (general for any num_kv). store_mask = row_in_range & (qi_seq+delta>=0) reproduces max_kv_idx>0. Paged gather k_cache[page_id,0,kv_head,:] with page_size=1 (page id==token id); duplicate pages via plain gather. output bf16, lse f32 base-2.

validation.correctness_reasoning: All 5 feedback WLs PASSED within atol=0.01 rtol=0.01 matched_ratio=0.99. Edge cases exercised: W3 duplicate pages (num_pages=2, 28 indices) abs=9.54e-7; W4 extreme single-seq tail (3 active of 16384) abs=7.15e-7; single/tiny-KV base-2 LSE (W1 abs=7.81e-3, W2 abs=3.91e-3, W5 abs=3.91e-3). Inactive rows/sequences left as zeros/-inf by allocation.

decision_reason: New best (first valid candidate). All 5 WLs pass correctness; geomean 92.36x. Establishes correctness baseline. Next: c002 compact tail-only schedule to remove dead blocks on W3/W4 (many no-op query tiles) and push large-WL time toward the output-write floor.
